'''March 2001 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA on 13 March 2001. [[Matt Rudolph]] won it. It is known from Mark Balderston's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1892">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-va-beach-va-comic-alternative-3-13-01d1892/ va-beach-va-comic-alternative-3-13-01], DeckTech (Mark "Rogue Nine" Balderston, 13 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-13-va-beach-va-comic-alternative-3-13-01d1892/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Comic Alternative, Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Rudolph]]
